description: Grants a Sentry team access to a Sentry project within the specified Sentry organization.

inputSchema.description: Defines the parameters required to add a Sentry team to a Sentry project.

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug for the Sentry organization. This organization contains both the project and the team.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

project_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug for the Sentry project. Access will be granted to this project.
project_id_or_slug.title: Project Id Or Slug

team_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug for the Sentry team that will be granted access to the project.
team_id_or_slug.title: Team Id Or Slug

inputSchema.title: AddTeamToProjectRequest

name: add_team_to_project

AddTeamToProjectResponse.description: Represents the Sentry project details after a team has been successfully added to it.

hasSessions.description: Indicates whether the project has session data.
hasSessions.title: Has Sessions

access.description: List of permission scopes the current user has for this project (e.g., 'project:admin', 'project:read').
access.title: Access

firstTransactionEvent.description: Indicates whether the project has received any transaction events.
firstTransactionEvent.title: First Transaction Event

hasTraceMetrics.description: Indicates whether the project has trace metrics.
hasTraceMetrics.title: Has Trace Metrics

isBookmarked.description: Indicates whether the current user has bookmarked this project.
isBookmarked.title: Is Bookmarked

hasInsightsVitals.description: Indicates whether the project has vitals insights enabled.
hasInsightsVitals.title: Has Insights Vitals

dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the project was created.
dateCreated.title: Date Created

hasInsightsScreenLoad.title: Has Insights Screen Load

hasLogs.description: Indicates whether the project has log data.
hasLogs.title: Has Logs

hasInsightsMCP.description: Indicates whether the project has MCP insights enabled.
hasInsightsMCP.title: Has Insights Mcp

hasFeedbacks.description: Indicates whether the project has user feedbacks.
hasFeedbacks.title: Has Feedbacks

hasInsightsDb.description: Indicates whether the project has database insights enabled.
hasInsightsDb.title: Has Insights Db

isMember.description: Indicates whether the current user is a member of this project.

isPublic.description: Indicates whether this project is publicly accessible.

hasProfiles.description: Indicates whether the project has profiling data.
hasProfiles.title: Has Profiles

hasMonitors.description: Indicates whether the project has monitors configured.

firstEvent.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the first event received by this project, or null if no events have been received.

platform.description: The programming language or framework platform for the project (e.g., 'javascript', 'python').

hasNewFeedbacks.description: Indicates whether the project has new feedbacks.

hasInsightsQueues.description: Indicates whether the project has queue insights enabled.

hasReplays.description: Indicates whether the project has session replays.

hasInsightsCaches.description: Indicates whether the project has cache insights enabled.
hasInsightsCaches.title: Has Insights Caches

team.title: Team

features.description: List of enabled Sentry features for this project (e.g., 'alert-filters', 'custom-inbound-filters').
